assumptions.summary: All coauthor ties have equal strength.
Paper significance depends on citations, publication date, and journal influence.
IMDb rating measures movie quality and Google results measure star popularity.
The ideal influence profile is maximum degree and betweenness with minimum closeness.
Normalized journal impact factors are appropriate initial PageRank values.
Leading-supporting roles define actor-link direction and IMDb ratings define its weight.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: More than 18,000 raw rows are filtered to 511 Erdos1 authors and a 511-order coauthor matrix.
Top-50 authors are selected for the Figure 1 visualization.
Sixteen supplied and eight discovered papers form a 24-node citation network.
Journal impact factors initialize the citation PageRank.
Citations per year supply popularity for papers.
Fifteen actors and their co-star movies form a directed rating-weighted graph.
Google search results supply actor popularity but no date or locale is given.

Node degrees from the coauthor matrix feed the distribution diagnostic.
The PageRank recurrence transfers from citation nodes to rating-weighted actor edges.
The actor PageRank reference at q=0.85 supplies the sensitivity comparator.
Relation-distance rankings and closeness paths supply the proposed access route.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The Summary's requirement map improves scanability but does not establish why this organization earned Outstanding status.
Using the Harary exception to disclose a metric weakness makes the model boundary visible without externally validating either rank.
Naming dangling-node failure before the repair exposes a real implementation concern, although the displayed fix remains incomplete.
The small 3:4 allocation helps readers inspect an otherwise abstract edge-weight transfer.
A final explicit data-volume weakness bounds broad portability claims but does not repair them.

language_observations.summary: Human style comes from explicit simplification, comparison exceptions, named failure states, worked transfers, parameter interpretation, and concrete weaknesses rather than connective-word density.
summary turns requirements into a network-analysis chain: Move from coauthor ranking through citation and actor cases to scale-free advice.
introduction maps each requirement to a named model: Name the relation-distance, authority-popularity, and weighted-link variants before the sections that implement them.
unmeasurable tie strength triggers a binary simplification: Name the unavailable coauthor-strength criterion, set a binary relation, and carry the loss of detail forward.
raw records become a named relation matrix: Extract eligible authors, remove the wrong distance class, assign IDs, and construct the matrix.
three centralities become one normalized measure vector: Define degree, betweenness, and closeness roles before normalization into a common vector.
an ideal point turns a multi-index profile into a distance rank: Set the best vector, calculate Euclidean distance, then rank smaller distances higher.
two ranked tables expose a degree-driven weakness: Compare overlap, isolate Harary as an exception, explain the coauthor-quality difference, and bound the first ranking.
a fitted degree plot becomes a scale-free claim: Report the estimated exponent, show the empirical and approximate curves, then name the network class.
dangling-node failure triggers modified PageRank: State that random surfing is trapped, count dangling nodes, and introduce initialization plus iteration.
journal impact factors become initial authority weights: Collect impact factors, normalize them into initial PageRank values, and distinguish initialization from citations.
an explicit stopping tolerance leads into an authority table: State damping and tolerance, iterate to stability, list ranks, then name the leading paper.
authority and popularity are separated before quadrant interpretation: Pair stable PageRank with citations per year, define four regions, then select the upper-right paper.
a citation-network mechanism transfers by moving weight to edges: Keep PageRank, change node weights into movie-rating link weights, and revise outgoing allocation.
a numerical mini-case makes a weighted transition inspectable: Show two outgoing ratings, normalize their sum, and calculate the split received by each target.
damping intuition leads into a sensitivity check: Explain the equal-opportunity term, vary q against the q=0.85 reference, and read similarity as stability.
claimed versatility closes with a specific data-volume limitation: List breadth, portability, simplicity, and flexibility, then admit large errors for limited networks.

scale-free growth and attachment become an actionable access strategy: Explain growth and preferential attachment, acknowledge inaccessible key nodes, then route through more approachable short paths.
a figure or table is read into a bounded next action: Name the observed ranking, fit, or quadrant, state its analytical purpose, and specify the next check or decision.
an assumption is followed by why it changes the computation: State the simplifying premise, give the practical reason, and name the matrix or weight it controls.
a local result is offered for transfer with data conditions: Name a university, journal, or actor setting, state which matrix or weights must be recollected, and bound reuse.

title: Who are the 20%?
unresolved_questions: The summary says ALON is most influential while the Relation Distance table later ranks HARARY first; the distinction is not surfaced in the Summary.
Equal coauthor strength ignores paper count, recency, role, and collaboration quality.
Paper significance mixes citations, publication date, and journal influence without a defined formula or collection date.
Movie quality and star popularity are proxied by IMDb rating and Google hits without temporal normalization or validity evidence.
The Erdos1 extraction and Erdos2 removal rules are described informally; no reproducible raw-data parser or retained-author list is supplied.
The source calls the displayed sum of path lengths closeness centrality, but does not invert or otherwise reconcile its direction with the smaller-is-better ideal.
Equal maximum normalization and the ideal vector (1,1,0) impose a compensatory metric choice without weights, sensitivity, or disconnected-node policy.
The top-50 visualization is selected for observability, so it does not show the full 511-node structure or selection uncertainty.
Eigenvector centrality is computed in UCINET without solver settings, matrix version, direction convention, or reproducible output.
The single Harary exception supports a plausible critique of degree but does not validate either ranking against an external outcome.
The power-law statement supplies an exponent but no fit interval, goodness-of-fit statistic, tail threshold, or competing-distribution comparison.
The 24-paper citation network includes eight discovered additions without a search protocol, cutoff date, or complete citation data.
The citation edge direction is chosen for PageRank but its relation to the later matrix convention is not formally audited.
The authors identify three dangling nodes as a failure mode, but the shown update and flow chart do not specify redistribution for them.
Journal impact factor is used as initial paper authority even though it is venue-level, time-varying, and can double count later citation prestige.
The PageRank formula and reported ranks omit iteration count, convergence norm, dangling treatment, numerical trace, and a reproducible matrix.
The authority-popularity diagram uses transformed axes and dashed quadrants without declared cutoffs or uncertainty, so upper-right selection is visual only.
Actor direction relies on leading versus supporting roles, but the data source and rules for ensemble, co-lead, and temporal role assignment are absent.
IMDb ratings are treated as proportional influence-transfer weights without evidence that ratings cause career-network authority.
Google search results are volatile, personalized, locale-dependent, and unversioned, making the popularity comparison irreproducible.
Similarity changes with damping are plotted without an explicit tested range, similarity definition, rank-stability measure, or acceptability threshold.
The stated weakness only says limited data increase error; it gives no sample threshold, uncertainty interval, or repair experiment.
The 80-20 principle is used as network philosophy without verifying a 20 percent share for any presented influence measure.
The proposed shortcut toward influential authors can amplify existing preferential attachment and lacks ethical, access, or outcome safeguards.
Figure 11 is decorative as a strategy sketch: it provides no scale, algorithm, observed example, or decision evaluation.
No source datasets, code, matrix files, software settings, data dates, or machine-readable rankings are released.
